spans.s:
पृत् f. An army. (This word has
no forms for the first five inflections
and is optionally substituted for
पृतना after acc. dual).

1 An army (in general).
--2 A division of an army consisting
of 243 elephants, as many chariots,
729 horse, and 1215 foot.
--3 Battle,
fight, encounter.
--4 A hostile army.
--5 (pl.) Men, mankind (Ved.).
--Comp.
--साहः an epithet of Indra.

पृतन्यति Den. P. To attack,
encounter.
